description: Three test failures, each an independent test-helper bug, but bundled under INC-002 because they share the same root-cause class (test fixture pre-dates migrations 096/1156 schema additions): (A) TC-PRM-06-03 — `insertPromotionReviewsRow` does not set the `requested_by` NOT NULL column added by migration 096 → sqlstate 23502. (B) TC-PRM-07-03 — `insertPromotionAssertionRunsRow` (or sibling) inserts into `promotion_assertion_runs` without first seeding a parent `promotion_reviews` row → sqlstate 23503. (C) TC-PRM-07-01 — sandbox teardown failure simulation marker does not propagate into the post-condition `promotion_assertion_runs.status` setter. Pre-existing, NOT GH-785 regressions; out of scope for WF03-GH785-20260815. To be picked up by its own WF-03 cycle.

actions: Integration-test fixtures must be kept in sync with schema migrations that add NOT NULL / FK columns: when a migration adds a NOT NULL or FK column to a table the tests seed, the corresponding test helper INSERT must include the new column (or seed the FK parent) in the same change, and the suite must be run against the migration set that introduces the constraint.

Qualify manual UPDATE statements in test code to the same schema as the INSERT/SELECT they target (e.g. public.promotion_assertion_runs) rather than relying on search_path — a zero-UUID tenant context resolves unqualified names to tenant_default, silently matching 0 rows.

Maintain PRM test fixtures in the single combined file tests/integration/prm-06-07-promotion-assertion.test.zig (target test-integration-prm06-07); do not split into prm-06/prm-07 files, and do not cite migrations 1144/1145 for promotion_reviews schema facts (the NOT NULL columns are migration 096; the review FK is migration 1156).
